===== airport_connections.vl.json [zero shapes] =====
// Generated by vl2plot.vegaLiteToPlotCode(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as Plot from "@observablehq/plot";
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  let chartData = await d3.json(new URL("data/us-10m.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  // vl2plot: unsupported mark type "geoshape", skipped (--ignore-unsupported)
  let chartData2 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/flights-airport.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  chartData2 = chartData2.filter(d => true /* vl2d3: unsupported filter predicate shape {"param":"org","empty":false}, keeping every row (--ignore-unsupported) */);
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "lookup" (--ignore-unsupported)
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "lookup" (--ignore-unsupported)
  let chartData3 = await d3.csv(new URL("data/flights-airport.csv", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url), d3.autoType);
  chartData3 = Array.from(d3.rollup(chartData3, rows => ({"origin": rows[0]["origin"], "routes": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["origin"]])).values());
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "lookup" (--ignore-unsupported)
  chartData3 = chartData3.filter(d => d.state !== 'PR' && d.state !== 'VI');
  const node = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    width: 900,
    height: 500,
    r: {legend: null},
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX(chartData2, {
    stroke: "#000",
    opacity: 0.35,
  }),
      Plot.dot(chartData3, {
    r: "routes",
  }),
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}

// Generated by vl2plot.vegaLiteToPlotCode(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as Plot from "@observablehq/plot";
import * as d3 from "d3";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  let chartData = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  chartData = d3.bin().value(d => d["IMDB Rating"]).thresholds(20)(chartData).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "binned rating": bin.x0, "binned rating_end": bin.x1})));
  const node = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    marks: [
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}

    document: container.ownerDocument,
    width: 500,
    height: 300,
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(chartData2, {
    fill: () => "steelblue",
    r: 10,
  }),
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}

===== layer_cumulative_histogram.vl.json [zero shapes] =====
// Generated by vl2plot.vegaLiteToPlotCode(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as Plot from "@observablehq/plot";
import * as d3 from "d3";
import {vlWindow} from "./vl2plot-runtime.js";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  let chartData = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  chartData = d3.bin().value(d => d["IMDB Rating"]).thresholds(20)(chartData).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_IMDB_Rating": bin.x0, "bin_IMDB_Rating_end": bin.x1})));
  chartData = Array.from(d3.rollup(chartData, rows => ({"bin_IMDB_Rating": rows[0]["bin_IMDB_Rating"], "bin_IMDB_Rating_end": rows[0]["bin_IMDB_Rating_end"], "count": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["bin_IMDB_Rating"], d["bin_IMDB_Rating_end"]])).values());
  chartData = chartData.filter(d => d.bin_IMDB_Rating !== null);
  chartData = vlWindow(chartData, {window: [{"op":"sum","field":"count","as":"Cumulative Count"}], groupby: [], sort: [{"field":"bin_IMDB_Rating"}], frame: [null,0]});
  let chartData2 = await d3.json(new URL("data/movies.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  chartData2 = d3.bin().value(d => d["IMDB Rating"]).thresholds(20)(chartData2).flatMap(bin => bin.map(d => ({...d, "bin_IMDB_Rating": bin.x0, "bin_IMDB_Rating_end": bin.x1})));
  chartData2 = Array.from(d3.rollup(chartData2, rows => ({"bin_IMDB_Rating": rows[0]["bin_IMDB_Rating"], "bin_IMDB_Rating_end": rows[0]["bin_IMDB_Rating_end"], "count": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["bin_IMDB_Rating"], d["bin_IMDB_Rating_end"]])).values());
  chartData2 = chartData2.filter(d => d.bin_IMDB_Rating !== null);
  chartData2 = vlWindow(chartData2, {window: [{"op":"sum","field":"count","as":"Cumulative Count"}], groupby: [], sort: [{"field":"bin_IMDB_Rating"}], frame: [null,0]});
  const node = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    marks: [
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}

===== rect_mosaic_simple.vl.json [zero shapes] =====
// Generated by vl2plot.vegaLiteToPlotCode(spec, {ignoreUnsupported: true, includeSourcePaths: false})
import * as Plot from "@observablehq/plot";
import * as d3 from "d3";
import {vlStack} from "./vl2plot-runtime.js";

export default async function chart(container, options = {}) {
  let chartData = await d3.json(new URL("data/cars.json", options.baseURL ?? import.meta.url));
  chartData = Array.from(d3.rollup(chartData, rows => ({"Origin": rows[0]["Origin"], "Cylinders": rows[0]["Cylinders"], "count_*": rows.length}), d => JSON.stringify([d["Origin"], d["Cylinders"]])).values());
  chartData = vlStack(chartData, {field: "count_*", groupby: [], sort: [{"field":"Origin","order":"ascending"}], offset: "normalize", as: ["stack_count_Origin1","stack_count_Origin2"]});
  // vl2plot: skipped unsupported transform type "joinaggregate" (--ignore-unsupported)
  chartData = vlStack(chartData, {field: "count_*", groupby: ["Origin"], sort: [{"field":"Cylinders","order":"ascending"}], offset: "normalize", as: ["y","y2"]});
  const node = Plot.plot({
    document: container.ownerDocument,
    x: {axis: null},
    y: {axis: null},
    color: {legend: true},
    opacity: {legend: null},
    marks: [
      Plot.rect(chartData, {
    x1: "x",
    x2: "x2",
    y1: "y",
    y2: "y2",
    fill: "Origin",
    opacity: "Cylinders",
    title: "Origin",
  }),
    ],
  });
  container.appendChild(node);
  return node;
}
